edis_press_releases shortcode/template now render a PRNewswire/Business Wire badge and support a 'provider' filter attribute, proving the pressreleases-type + provider-subtype model on the WordPress-as-consumer side per founder's own explicit ask. php -l clean. Commit 7bc09ed.

title: Press-release provider badge + shortcode filter (proves prtype on WordPress)
